result.instructions: Tools for BoxHero, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which items have less than 10 units left in my main warehouse?"; "Show the last 20 stock-out transactions and who the customers were."; "Record a stock-in of 40 units of SKU-1042 at the Berlin location from supplier Acme.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes BoxHero data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run boxhero_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run boxhero_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run boxhero_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. boxhero_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: boxhero_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: The BoxHero team this API token belongs to: id, name, currency (code, symbol, price decimals), memo and mode. The API needs the team in LOCATION mode (mode 2) for items, locations, transactions and orders. GET /teams/linked.

tools.name: boxhero_list_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the active team members (id, name, role admin/member/viewer). Use the ids to filter orders by creator. GET /members.

tools.name: boxhero_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List inventory items with SKU, barcode, cost, price, custom attributes, total quantity and the per-location stock breakdown. Pass location_ids to limit the quantities (and the list) to items with stock at those locations; item_ids to fetch specific items. Cursor-paged by id; pass next_cursor to continue. Low-stock checks: compare quantity with the item's 'Minimum Stock' style attribute. GET /items.

location_ids.description: Scope quantities to these locations and list only items with nonzero stock there.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous reply's next_cursor. Omit on the first call.

tools.name: boxhero_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: One item by id, with its attributes, total quantity and stock per location. GET /items/{item_id}.

tools.name: boxhero_get_item_by_sku
tools.title: Get item by SKU
tools.description: Look up one item by its SKU (case-insensitive) and return the same payload as boxhero_get_item. No item with that SKU returns { found: false } (not an error). GET /items/by-sku/{sku}.

tools.name: boxhero_list_item_attributes
tools.title: List item attributes
tools.description: List the custom attribute specs defined for items (id, attr_name, attr_type text/date/number/barcode, rank). The ids are used when creating or updating items. File-type attributes are not included. GET /item-attrs.

tools.name: boxhero_create_item
tools.title: Create item
tools.description: WRITE: create a new inventory item. Optionally seed initial stock with quantity (and location_id when the team has more than one active location; with one location it is used automatically). Without quantity the item starts at zero everywhere. The SKU must be unique in the team (a random one is generated when omitted). Initial stock is applied in a second step, so on a partial failure the item may exist without stock. POST /items.

sku.description: SKU, unique in the team. Omit to let BoxHero generate one.

cost.description: Decimal string with up to 3 decimal places, e.g. "12.50".

price.description: Decimal string with up to 3 decimal places, e.g. "12.50".

value.description: Value: text/barcode as a string, date as YYYY-MM-DD, number as a number.

location_id.description: Location to seed the initial quantity at.

tools.name: boxhero_update_item
tools.title: Update item
tools.description: WRITE: change an item's name, SKU, barcode, photo, cost, price or custom attributes. Only the fields you pass change (an attribute with value null is removed; photo_url '' clears the photo). Stock levels are NOT changed here: use boxhero_record_stock_transaction. PUT /items/{item_id}.

sku.description: New SKU (unique in the team); an empty value is ignored.

cost.description: Decimal string with up to 3 decimal places, e.g. "12.50".

price.description: Decimal string with up to 3 decimal places, e.g. "12.50".

attrs.description: Attribute values to patch: [{ id, value }].

value.description: New value, or null to remove the attribute value.

tools.name: boxhero_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the active storage locations (warehouses, stores...) with id, name, memo and total quantity stored. Location ids are needed for stock transactions. GET /locations.

tools.name: boxhero_get_location
tools.title: Get location
tools.description: One location by id. GET /locations/{location_id}.

tools.name: boxhero_create_location
tools.title: Create location
tools.description: WRITE: create a storage location. The name must be unique in the team; the plan's location limit applies (HTTP 402 when over it). POST /locations.

name.description: Location name, unique in the team.

tools.name: boxhero_update_location
tools.title: Update location
tools.description: WRITE: rename a location or change its memo (memo '' clears it). Only the fields you pass change. PUT /locations/{location_id}.

name.description: New name, unique in the team.

tools.name: boxhero_list_partners
tools.title: List partners
tools.description: List business partners: suppliers (type 0, used on Stock In) and customers (type 1, used on Stock Out) with contact details. Cursor-paged by id. GET /partners.

type.description: 0 = suppliers only, 1 = customers only. Omit for both.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous reply's next_cursor. Omit on the first call.

tools.name: boxhero_get_partner
tools.title: Get partner
tools.description: One partner (supplier or customer) by id. GET /partners/{partner_id}.

tools.name: boxhero_create_partner
tools.title: Create partner
tools.description: WRITE: add a supplier (type 0) or customer (type 1) to BoxHero. It only stores contact details; BoxHero does not contact the partner. The plan's partner limit applies (HTTP 402). POST /partners.

type.description: 0 = supplier (Stock In), 1 = customer (Stock Out). Cannot be changed later.

tools.name: boxhero_update_partner
tools.title: Update partner
tools.description: WRITE: change a partner's name or contact details. The name is required by BoxHero (pass the current one to keep it); the other fields change only when passed. A partner's type cannot be changed. PUT /partners/{partner_id}.

name.description: Partner name (required; pass the current name to keep it).

tools.name: boxhero_list_transactions
tools.title: List stock transactions
tools.description: List stock transactions (Stock In, Stock Out, Move, Adjust), newest first, as summaries: type, locations, partner, memo, time, creator, item count, total quantity and revision. Use boxhero_get_transaction for the line items and new stock levels. Filter by type. Cursor-paged; pass next_cursor to continue. GET /transactions.

type.description: in = Stock In, out = Stock Out, move = Move Stock, adjust = Adjust Stock.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous reply's next_cursor. Omit on the first call.

tools.name: boxhero_get_transaction
tools.title: Get stock transaction
tools.description: One stock transaction by id with all its lines; pass revision for an earlier version of it. GET /transactions/{tx_id}.

revision.description: A historical revision; omit for the latest.

tools.name: boxhero_record_stock_transaction
tools.title: Record stock transaction
tools.description: WRITE: record a stock movement that CHANGES stock levels. type 'in' adds stock at to_location_id (optional supplier partner_id), 'out' removes stock at to_location_id (optional customer partner_id; stock may go negative), 'move' transfers from from_location_id to to_location_id, 'adjust' applies a signed RELATIVE correction at to_location_id (quantity 50 adds 50, -3 removes 3; it is not a target level). For in/out/move give each line a positive quantity (the tool applies the sign); for adjust it is signed and non-zero. Each line names an item by item_id or item_sku. to_location_id may be omitted only when the team has exactly one active location. Repeating the call records the movement again. Transactions can be edited or deleted only in the BoxHero app. POST /transactions.

type.description: in = Stock In, out = Stock Out, move = Move Stock, adjust = Adjust Stock.

quantity.description: Positive amount for in/out/move; signed non-zero for adjust.

to_location_id.description: The location stock arrives at / leaves from / is adjusted at. Optional only with a single location.

partner_id.description: Supplier (in) or customer (out); not allowed on move or adjust.

tx_time.description: Effective time, ISO 8601 with timezone, not in the future; defaults to now; not allowed on adjust.

tools.name: boxhero_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List purchase orders (stock you ordered from suppliers), newest first: order number, status, supplier, totals, estimated date. Line items and fulfillment progress come from boxhero_get_purchase_order. Cursor-paged. GET /purchase-orders.

tags.description: Only orders carrying ALL these tags.

created_by_id.description: Only orders created by this member id (boxhero_list_members).

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous reply's next_cursor. Omit on the first call.

tools.name: boxhero_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get purchase order
tools.description: One purchase order by id with every line (item, price, quantity, tax, discount), additional costs, tags, custom fields and fulfillment progress. GET /purchase-orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: boxhero_list_sales_orders
tools.title: List sales orders
tools.description: List sales orders (stock you sold to customers), newest first: order number, status, customer, totals, estimated date. Line items, returns and fulfillment progress come from boxhero_get_sales_order. Cursor-paged. GET /sales-orders.

tags.description: Only orders carrying ALL these tags.

created_by_id.description: Only orders created by this member id (boxhero_list_members).

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous reply's next_cursor. Omit on the first call.

tools.name: boxhero_get_sales_order
tools.title: Get sales order
tools.description: One sales order by id with every line (item, price, quantity, returned quantity), additional costs, tags, custom fields and fulfillment progress. GET /sales-orders/{order_id}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with BoxHero
prompts.description: What you can do with BoxHero here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_items_that_are_running_low
prompts.title: Find items that are running low
prompts.description: List the items with their stock per location. Compare each quantity with a minimum-stock attribute, if your team has one, and list the items below it.

prompts.name: review_the_latest_stock_outs_and_their_customers
prompts.title: Review the latest stock-outs and their customers
prompts.description: List the newest stock transactions, filtered to stock-outs. The entries show the customer where one was set. Open one transaction to see its lines.

prompts.name: record_a_stock_in_from_a_supplier
prompts.title: Record a stock-in from a supplier
prompts.description: Find the item by its SKU, then the receiving location and the supplier. Record the stock-in with the quantity. Each repeated call records the movement again, so check the transaction list first.

prompts.name: check_what_is_still_to_be_received_on_purchase_orders
prompts.title: Check what is still to be received on purchase orders
prompts.description: List the purchase orders with their status and estimated date. Open one to see each line and the quantity still to be received.

prompts.name: add_a_new_item_with_its_opening_stock
prompts.title: Add a new item with its opening stock
prompts.description: Read the custom attributes and the locations first. Create the item with its SKU and price, and an opening quantity if you want stock at once.
